name: local llama
author: mihai
description: Load and unload the local llama.cpp models (Qwen3-4B, 8B, 30B) from the Omarchy bar. Nothing occupies RAM or VRAM until you pick a model and click Load; the widget shows the model's load state so you know when opencode can talk to it.

barWidget.description: Start/stop the local Qwen3 llama.cpp servers and show which model is currently loaded for opencode.
